LanguageData.ER_QuestDescription:
A fragment of an old transmission mentions a shipment of resurrector mech serum. Most of the coordinates are missing, but the trail leads to an enemy outpost nearby. Whoever holds it may have kept the shipment records.

Other outposts are mentioned in the transmission. Following the trail could take you far from home. Their occupants are unlikely to welcome visitors.

If you hope to bring {0} back, preserve their remains.
LanguageData.ER_StageDescription: The trail leads to a guarded outpost. Securing it should give you a chance to recover the missing shipment records.\n\nThe location will remain accessible for 30 days. Leave its defenders in control, and this lead may be lost.
LanguageData.ER_FinalDescription: The records point to the last outpost linked to the serum shipment. Its defenders appear better prepared than the others.\n\nSecure the site to release the shipment. You have 30 days before the connection is lost.
LanguageData.ER_TerminalDiscovered: A terminal containing mechanite archive information has been discovered.
LanguageData.ER_SettingsDelay: Quest arrival after an eligible colonist dies
LanguageData.ER_SettingsMinimumMembership: Minimum time as a colonist: {0} days
LanguageData.ER_SettingsMembershipExplanation: 0–60 days of actual colonist membership. Set to 0 to allow newly joined colonists. Prisoners, slaves, guests and other ineligible pawns remain excluded.
LanguageData.ER_SettingsTimingExplanation: Applies to future deaths. A scheduled opportunity keeps its original arrival time. Immediately means the next game tick; the game must be unpaused. The 60-day global cooldown and one-chain limit still apply.
